scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Disguise?
scripts.translation:
[死者]
你獵殺夠50只假面鬼了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只。

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Remember, I need help hunting Disguise so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺假面鬼，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[死者]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Please kill 50 Disguise in order to make this a Place were people can go to and gather Experience.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
請獵殺50只假面鬼，好讓大家能在這裡練級。

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
真厲害，這麼快就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Oh great!
You are here to help me right?
If not, i don't know what to do with the Monsters in this Place!
scripts.translation:
[死者]
太好了！
你是來幫我的吧？
不然真不知道該拿這裡的魔物怎麼辦！

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Great! I knew the moment i saw you that i can count on you!
I need you to reduce the Amount of Monsters which are currently rampaging on this Map!
There are to many Disguise and Loli Ruri around, which makes it impossible for the lower level players to gain good experience here.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
太好了，一看你就知道靠得住！
幫我減少這張地圖上肆虐的魔物吧！
假面鬼和銀月魔女實在太多，低等級玩家根本沒法在這裡好好練級。

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
So, which of those Monsters would you like to hunt for me?
scripts.translation:
[死者]
那麼，你打算幫我獵殺哪種魔物？

scripts.text: Disguise
scripts.translation: 假面鬼

scripts.text: Loli Ruri
scripts.translation: 銀月魔女

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Thank you for your great help with the Disguise!
Currently the Situation is stable and i'm not in need of your help anymore to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
謝謝你幫忙對付假面鬼！
目前情況已經穩定，暫時不用再幫忙獵殺了。

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Kill 50 of those Disguise and let me know when you're done. I will reward you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[死者]
去獵殺50只假面鬼，完成後回來告訴我。
我會給你報酬。

Oh boy, Oh boy!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Deadman]
Sorry I can't talk right now I am in a world of pain here, these darn Disguise and Loli Ruri are going to kill me.
scripts.translation:

抱歉，顧不上說話了，我正受苦呢，這些該死的假面鬼和銀月魔女快把我逼死了。
